_note: Every target is confirmed from a repo source, cited per-target in 'source'. Provider API bases: ops/quota/provider-managers.json records documentation sources only (no API base field), so the bases below are taken from the wired adapter/catalog modules that registry indexes (scripts/provider_model_catalog.py, scripts/provider_quota_managers.py, scripts/ops/allocation_probe.py) — the exact URLs fleet code calls. Probes are unauthenticated GETs; 401/404 responses are expected and fine (timing is the product). The Neon and Koyeb entries use the API hosts the fleet itself calls (console.neon.tech /api/v2 per scripts/quota_poll.py; app.koyeb.com /v1 per the deploy workflow), which are the same API surfaces as api.neon.tech / api.koyeb.com.
